name: Deckel SO single-lip cutter grinder
description: Manual single-lip cutter and tool grinder for profile and flute grinding of form tools; the indexing workhead holds the cutter in a collet against a cup wheel.
source_files: Deckel SO flute grinder.step (exported from the IGES in Fusion)

notes: GrabCAD's model is only the SO's indexing workhead (248 mm long, true size): IGES only (113 MB), imported in Fusion and exported to STEP. planner.compose.deckel_so sets it on a modelled stand, base, swivel table and wheel head, sized for an SO on its stand (about 24 x 18 x 46 in).
